items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I saw old Roy Zinnerman over there, St. Augustine. He was playing with that band, with the Coast Guard Band.

ctx.x: That's about the time I left Joe's Inn and the war came on. Yeah. We had the little business and before you know it all of the personnel that actually ran the business was in A1 classification with the draft board. I was the last one so I got a little deformity until I got somebody broken in to run the business. There's another case like music. I had a machine shop. I had a business. Just like music. But they were setting other guys up building machine shops for them and putting them in business so they could…
